craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta-vīra of the Lord's array, limb by limb — weapon-and-ensign song. Hurl-to-unmake; goad-makes-plain. Rejected: (a) unmake→destroy → killed: unmake unmakes. Read aloud: DIFF-er-ence-MADE … SU-preme-BHAI-ra-va, TO-us.

lines: Difference-made, all, this — by own power I hurl to unmake;
so goad-held makes plain — supreme Bhairava, to us.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhedamayam akhilam etan nijaśaktyaivākṣipāmi saṃhartum | aṅkuśadhāraṇataḥ sphuṭayati parabhairavo 'smākam

reads_against.argmap: What is hurled to destroy? → Hurled to destroy by own power; goad makes plain.
c1_essence: Borne pointed; opposed unopposed in me.
Impassioned cloth cast; bloodied hide told.
Dagger bared splitting; taken-world heroes best.
Noosed time counted; death's death shown.
Hurled to unmake; goad makes plain.
Bow shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer deer-pierced.
